query: UPDATE customers SET loyalty_points = loyalty_points + 44 WHERE tenant_id = 1 AND customer_id = 510

UPDATE customers c SET loyalty_points = (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total_cents), 0) DIV 100 FROM orders o WHERE o.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.order_state = 'paid') WHERE c.tenant_id = 1 AND c.customer_id BETWEEN 401 AND 600
